provenance: New evaluator-authored fictional scenarios, frozen before inference. No user records, private content, training examples or model outputs were used to write these cases.

cases.prompt: <PLATFORM_INSTAGRAM> <GOAL_STREAMS> <TONE_CASUAL> <FORMAT_REEL> <LENGTH_SHORT> <CTA_SOFT> Target audience: fans of mellow piano beats. The fictional instrumental is called Paper Lantern Harbor. Write one short release hook inviting listeners to hear it. <STAGE_HOOK>
cases.criteria: Readable release hook about mellow piano music; invites listening; no invented chart position or audience numbers.

cases.prompt: <PLATFORM_TIKTOK> <GOAL_ENGAGEMENT> <TONE_CASUAL> <FORMAT_REEL> <LENGTH_SHORT> <CTA_SOFT> Target audience: beginner beat makers. Show how a dry handclap becomes a roomy handclap with reverb. Write a short hook for this demonstration. <STAGE_HOOK>
cases.criteria: Readable hook specifically contrasting dry and reverberant claps; no unrelated sales claims.

cases.prompt: <PLATFORM_INSTAGRAM> <STAGE_CAPTION> Write a caption under 35 words for a fictional free acoustic set at the Cedar Room on October 18 at 7 pm. Invite people to attend. Do not invent a street address or ticket link.
cases.criteria: Coherent invitation; preserves venue, date and time; under 35 words; no invented address, price or link.

cases.prompt: <PLATFORM_INSTAGRAM> <STAGE_CAPTION> Write a caption under 35 words for a fictional 92 BPM boom bap instrumental called Copper Steps. Ask rappers what story they would tell over it. Do not claim any artist has used it.
cases.criteria: Coherent beat caption including 92 BPM or boom bap and a story question; no invented endorsement; under 35 words.

cases.prompt: <PLATFORM_YOUTUBE> <STAGE_HOOK> Write three short spoken lines for a beginner music video: first introduce a muddy vocal, then suggest lowering competing low mids in the backing track, then remind viewers to compare at equal loudness.
cases.criteria: Three intelligible lines covering muddy vocal, competing low mids and equal-loudness comparison; does not promise a universal perfect setting.

cases.prompt: <PLATFORM_TIKTOK> <STAGE_HOOK> Write three short lines for a fictional beat making clip: record a spoon tapping a cup, turn it into percussion, and ask viewers to name the rhythm. No celebrity names.
cases.criteria: Coherent sequence with spoon/cup source, percussion transformation and naming invitation; no celebrity claims.

cases.prompt:
<PLATFORM_TIKTOK> <GOAL_ENGAGEMENT> <STAGE_HOOK>
Performance: 1200 views, 15 saves, most viewers leave in the first two seconds.
Diffs: the current opening is five seconds of a silent logo.
Blocks: logo, drum demonstration, question.
Suggest one concise optimized revision without guaranteeing results.
cases.criteria: Recommends replacing or shortening silent opening and leading with sound/demo; no guaranteed growth or fabricated analytics.

cases.prompt:
<PLATFORM_INSTAGRAM> <GOAL_STREAMS> <STAGE_HOOK>
Performance: 800 views and 3 link clicks.
Diffs: caption never says where to listen.
Blocks: piano preview, cover art.
Suggest one concise caption revision. The only known destination is the link in bio. Do not invent a URL.
cases.criteria: Concrete listening CTA using link in bio; grounded in supplied facts; no invented URL or guaranteed improvement.

cases.prompt: <PLATFORM_INSTAGRAM> <STAGE_CAPTION> Facts for a fictional release: title Glass Orchard; instrumental; release date November 6. Summarize in one sentence. The performer name and streaming totals are unknown, so do not invent them.
cases.criteria: One intelligible sentence preserving title, instrumental nature and date; no invented performer or stream totals.

cases.prompt: <PLATFORM_INSTAGRAM> <STAGE_CAPTION> Escribe una frase breve en español para presentar un ritmo instrumental tranquilo llamado Jardín de Cobre. Invita a escuchar. No inventes premios ni cifras.
cases.criteria: Intelligible Spanish invitation to listen to a calm instrumental; no invented awards or numbers.
